chat.author: Carsten Bormann
chat.text:
RFC 9650 ✓ (2024). Changes the “IS-IS Neighbor Link-Attribute Bit Values” registry from Standards Action to Expert Review, pointing experts to RFC 7370 and RFC 5029 for guidance. It’s only about three sections long. datatracker (https://datatracker.ietf.org/doc/rfc9650/)


RFC 7370 ✓, “Updates to the IS-IS TLV Codepoints Registry.” Moves the IS-IS registries to Expert Review and gives the general expert guidance that later IS-IS documents refer back to.


RFC 9029 ✓, “Updates to the Allocation Policy for the BGP-LS Parameters Registries.” Moves these registries to Expert Review and adds instructions for the experts.


RFC 8810, “Revision to Capability Codes Registration Procedures” (BGP).
